## DPIA Trigger

- [ ] Sensitive AI inference
- [ ] Biometric or identity signal
- [ ] Location or routine inference
- [ ] Minor or child-related data
- [ ] Data-sharing or monetization
- [ ] Large-scale passive collection
- [ ] New vendor or processor
- [ ] Other high-risk processing

## Required Review Materials

- [ ] Completed `docs/DPIA_TEMPLATE.md`
- [ ] Data inventory
- [ ] Feature privacy manifest
- [ ] Consent copy or consent flow
- [ ] Deletion/export behavior
- [ ] Audit event mapping
- [ ] Vendor review if applicable

## Decision

- [ ] Approved
- [ ] Approved with conditions
- [ ] Blocked

List required changes before launch.
